newsitem.title: UK: Flemings launches equity fund for emerging debt.
newsitem.headline: Flemings launches equity fund for emerging debt.

text.p: Robert Fleming and Co said on Monday it has launched a $155.4 million equity fund that will invest in emerging market debt on a leveraged basis.
Fleming Investment Management (FIM), which will manage the vehicle, said it was the first fund of its kind from a European investment manager.

"The fundamentals for investing in a diversified portfolio of emerging market debt are currently very attractive and will, we believe, continue to be so in the future," said David Boardman, head of fixed interest at FIM.
The fund has been constructed on a leveraged basis through the use of long term floating rate borrowing at a fixed rate over LIBOR, Robert Fleming and Co said in a statement released in London.
Its equity shares offer the investor a geared exposure to the underlying portfolio -- for each $100 of equity raised, the fund has raised approximately $400 of senior debt, it said.
Shane O'Riordain, Robert Fleming and Co's group marketing communications director, said its structure meant the fund could purchase much more debt than ordinary funds.

Marketed primarily to international institutional investors, with a 50 percent uptake in the United States and Britain, the fund has a maximum 10-year life and will offer the added comfort of a Bermuda listing.

Its portfolio consists mainly of debt securities or loans issued by sovereign borrowers and emerging market corporates, with about one third of the fund invested in U.S. high yield fixed interest instruments, the statement said.

It will have holdings in Latin America, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, emerging Europe, the Caribbean and the United States, and will work on the basis of an internal rate of return of 17 to 18 percent, O'Riordain added.
Its senior borrowings are rated Aa3 by Moodys Investor Services.
Separately, Robert Fleming is also launching a series of new emerging market research products in the new year.

These include a monthly global emerging markets strategy product, a monthly earnings book covering the top 500 companies in emerging markets worldwide, a monthly global emerging markets chart book, and a weekly emerging markets country funds book that will deal with some 400 funds, O'Riordain said. --Caroline Brothers, London Newsroom +44 171 542 2734
